name: Mrs. M. Wadsworth
bio: Mrs. Wadsworth served dinner to the editor's party at Wadsworth's ranch in late June 1884, and the paper called her the most hospitable of ladies. In October 1885 Miss Macbeth visited her at the ranch.

moments.label: Hosted the editor's party at Wadsworth's ranch

mentions: …w of some of the most wierd and imposing scenery of the Bad Lands, and to crown it all the best of dinners at Wadsworth's ranch served by the most hospitable of ladies, ought certainly to make a day full of pleasure. Mrs. Wadsworth and Mrs. McGregor will always be remembered with most kin…
H. B. Wadsworth, while superintending the Bad Lands cattle Co's. shipment of beeves at Dickinson, last Saturday, slipped and fell from the top of a caboose, breaking his leg in the fall…
Miss Macbeth returned Monday from a visit to Mrs. Wadsworth, at the ranch.
